title: Deadlock triage
prompt: Implement `static int SafeTransfer(Account a, Account b, int amount)` that moves `amount` from a to b using `Monitor.TryEnter` with a timeout on both locks, acquired in a CONSISTENT ORDER (by account id) so it can never deadlock — releasing cleanly on every path. Implement `static void UnsafeTransfer(...)` the naive way (lock a then lock b, in argument order) to demonstrate the ABBA deadlock the lesson catalogs. Return 1 on success, 0 on timeout in SafeTransfer.

tests.name: safe-transfer
tests.hint: Order by Id: first = a.Id < b.Id ? a : b; TryEnter(first, 1000); TryEnter(second, 1000); finally-release both.

tests.name: reverse-direction-safe
tests.hint: Same lock order regardless of argument order — that is the whole fix.
